findings.highlight: Tohsaka reaches behind her and takes out a dagger.
findings.evidenceJa: 言って、遠坂は背中に手を伸ばし、気だるそうに一振りの短剣を取り出した。
findings.governingReading: Rin reaches behind her and takes the dagger out with an apparently weary/languid movement.
findings.explanation: The wounded girl’s languid dagger withdrawal becomes an unqualified motion.
